items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: I studied drums with Freddy Albright

ctx.x: Oh yeah, very. Yes. Then I studied tympani with Sol Goodman, he was with the Philharmonic Symphony. And then I studied drums with Freddy Albright and quite oh, I studied xylophones with Milton Schlesinger, he's the one who used to do all the Lucky Strike Hours and things like that. So that's when I really started to get my feet into it, really, you know, and down to hard study was during those years, those gentlemen. Now of course with Billy Gladstone, I studied with him a couple of years. Shelly Mann, I was…
that I would be with and that's why I wasn't consistent with a lot of the teachers, because I was in and out of town all the time.
